calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS asof_sub, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(distinct (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, sum(f.quantity) units, min(f.quantity) minq, max(f.quantity) maxq, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(distinct f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' OR p.subcategory='Interior Paint')
GROUP BY 1,2

JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.quantity) u, sum(f.net_amount) n, count(distinct f.receipt_id) r
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) days, sum(a.u) fact_units, sum(r.units_sold) rpt_units, sum(a.n) fact_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net, sum(a.r) fact_receipts, sum(r.receipts) rpt_receipts,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.u<>r.units_sold) diff_days
FROM a FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') r ON r.business_date=a.d
